row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; seismic.com/pricing is 404)
row.evidence: Seismic's developer portal documents a SCIM 2.0 API at https://api.seismic.com/scim/v2 ("Creates a new user within the Seismic tenant using SCIM 2.0"), and Seismic publishes no prices; buyers are sent to a personalized demo.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public pricing (seismic.com/pricing is 404; Enablement Cloud Starter page lists licence types with Contact Us), so SCIM can only be bought through sales; no plan gate for SCIM or SSO is published. This row is the main Seismic Enablement platform (Seismic Content). The existing lessonly row ('Seismic Learning (Lessonly)') covers the Learning product: on upgraded tenants both products share the same Seismic Platform SCIM API, where one platform user can hold a Content role (Premium, Business, Partner) and a Learning role. SCIM: Users and Groups CRUD, PATCH replace only, active=false to deactivate, DELETE permanent, filter + pagination (max 100), no Bulk; JWT bearer from an OAuth client registered by a tenant admin. Okta OIN 'Seismic' app provisions over SCIM (Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push); the Entra gallery app is SAML only. Audit-record API and (Early Access) user webhooks exist.

plans.name: Seismic Enablement Cloud (quote-only)
plans.notes: Enablement Cloud Starter sells Standard, Partner and Intranet user licences; no prices or tier gates published.

scim.plan: Contact Sales (quote-only; no plan gate published)

auth.token_source: OAuth2/OIDC client registered by a tenant admin in the App Registration portal (apps.seismic.com); JWT bearer with seismic.user.manage (write) or seismic.user.view (read) scope

deprovision.data_retained: active=false via PATCH disables the user (locked, cannot log in); DELETE permanently removes the user from the tenant and cannot be reverted. For joint Content+Learning users, removing one product means patching off that role.

custom.how: Seismic extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:seismic:2.0:User (e.g. ssoId, location, biography) plus tenant-specific custom properties discovered via GET /scim/v2/Schemas

roles.how: SCIM 'roles' array (case-sensitive): Content roles Premium, Business, Partner and Learning roles Admin, Creator, Manager, Learner or custom; roles override the legacy userType.

rate_limits.text: Standard API tiering: 600 calls per 60 seconds for endpoints not otherwise listed (SCIM is not singled out); 429 with retry hint when exceeded.

limitations.text: PATCH supports only the replace operation (users and groups); group membership is managed through POST/DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{userId}/Groups/{groupId} rather than PATCH members.
Only one email, of type work, is supported.
PUT treats missing fields as null or fails the request.
Role-based Content/Learning management applies only to tenants upgraded to the FY24 Winter user-management model.

scim.notes: ServiceProviderConfig example reports patch and filter supported, bulk/sort/eTag/changePassword not supported, OAuth bearer token auth.

capabilities.notes: Seismic's user-management API is the SCIM API itself; the non-SCIM /integration/v2/users endpoints are read-only and marked legacy.

rate_limits.text: Tiered per endpoint; 600 calls per 60 seconds for most endpoints; audit query is Tier 2 (60 requests/minute per tenant).

limitations.text: User webhook events are Early Access.
Non-SCIM /integration/v2/users endpoints are legacy and read-only.

okta.notes: OIN 'Seismic' app marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from page markup). A separate 'Seismic Learning' OIN app (SAML, SCIM, Create/Update/Deactivate) belongs to the lessonly row.

entra.notes: Entra gallery tutorial is SP-initiated SAML only; users must be created in Seismic first.
